items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: from being a gospel tune to being an r-and-b tune. So there seemed to have been, if not a zeitgeist, at least an influx of the gospel church influence into the music, and Jimmy Smith.

Ray Charles was an influence. I think the reason he was an influence is because early Ray Charles, he was doing Charles Brown. He was doing Nat Cole. Right? But then he found this thing. He took gospel music as a source, and he did it so well. You’re right. Those songs, Drown in My Own Tears and The Nighttime is the Right Time and – the list goes on and on. I bought all of his records, because I think he touched me in that place where, when I was playing in our church and the people would testify, or they would…
Did you get to know him?
